summary: Serious print data defects on both pages: every Part II and Part IV comb-cell amount prints with '.00' centavos inside whole-peso comb slots (despite the official form header 'Do NOT enter Centavos', except Schedule 1 Col B Item 13 which omits '.00'); Schedule 3 Item 5 prints '2' next to the preprinted '2 %' so the MCIT rate reads '22%'; Schedule 1 Col A Item 10 prints '0' next to preprinted '0 %' ('00%') and Item 11 prints '0.00' beside preprinted '000'; plus shared plain-text-over-comb-tick collisions on Item 9 address, Item 13A treaty specify, Page 2 header name, and Schedule 4 Items 6a–6b.

test_data.profile: Juana Santos long-name/long-address demo profile (TIN 000-123-453-00000, RDO 008)
test_data.notes: 39/42 fields applied (3 penalty fields 21–23 refused because return is an overpayment). Schedule 4 Other Tax Credits is fixed at 2 rows (6a and 6b) with no Add row UI.

defects.description: Every monetary comb cell on Pages 1 and 2 (Part II Items 14–25 and Part IV Schedules 1–4, except Schedule 1 Col B Item 13) prints '.00' centavos into whole-peso comb slots even though official 1702Q specifies '(Do NOT enter Centavos)' and has 12 integer slots; the decimal point occupies a peso slot and shifts the amount digits left by three slots.

Preprinted static values are doubled by dynamic writes: Schedule 3 Item 5 MCIT Rate writes '2' beside the preprinted '2 %' so it reads '22%'; Schedule 1 Col A Item 10 writes '0' beside preprinted '0 %' ('00%'); Schedule 1 Col A Item 11 writes '0.00' in small plain text beside preprinted '000'.

Long plain-text values print across comb ticks on Page 1 Item 9 Registered Address (both lines), Page 1 Item 13A treaty specify, Page 2 Header Registered Name, and Page 2 Schedule 4 Items 6a and 6b specify.
Header Item 5 second ATC row ('IC 010' / 'DOMESTIC CORPORATION IN GENERAL - 25%') sits slightly cramped against the bottom border of its boxes.
Part IV Schedule 4 Other Tax Credits/Payments is fixed at two items (6a and 6b) with no Add row control, so overflow past the 2 printed rows cannot be entered.
Official 1702Q PDF has 3 pages (Page 3 is Guidelines/Instructions); the app renders 2 form pages.
